meta.name: ace-step
meta.description: Generate, inpaint, and outpaint music with ACE Step on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. ACE Step is StepFun-AI's open-weights music foundation model — tag-driven composition (genre, mood, instruments), multilingual lyrics with section markers, 5 s to 4 min stereo output, $0.0002–0.0003 per second (≈ 27× cheaper than ElevenLabs Music). Four endpoints: ACE Step text-to-audio (the default), ACE Step 1.5 text-to-audio (50+ language lyrics, refined structured-lyric handling), ACE Step audio-inpaint (regenerate a time range inside an existing track), ACE Step audio-outpaint (extend an existing track before or after). Triggers on "ace step", "ace-step", "acestep", "ACE music", "open music model", "cheap AI music", "inpaint audio", "audio inpaint", "extend music", "audio outpaint", "lengthen track", "music with tags", or any explicit ask to generate or edit music with ACE Step.

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成或编辑音乐
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或修改音乐片段
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit music from text descriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or modify music tracks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 能根据你给的标签（如风格、情绪、乐器）生成音乐，也能修改或延长已有的音频文件。
howto.when: 当你提到“ace step”、“生成音乐”、“修改音频”、“延长音乐”等关键词，或明确要求用 ACE Step 创作音乐时触发。

say.text: 用 ACE Step 生成一段 60 秒的 lo-fi 纯音乐。
把这段音频的第 20 到 40 秒换成钢琴独奏。
给这段 30 秒的旋律加 30 秒前奏和 60 秒尾奏。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate music from tags (genre, mood, instruments), and also inpaint or outpaint existing audio files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "ace step", "generate music", "inpaint audio", "extend music", or explicitly ask to use ACE Step for music creation.

say_en.text: Generate a 60-second lo-fi instrumental with ACE Step.
say_en.note: Claude will call text-to-audio to create instrumental music.

say_en.text: Replace seconds 20 to 40 of this audio with piano solo.
say_en.note: Claude will call audio-inpaint to regenerate that segment.

say_en.text: Add 30s intro and 60s outro to this 30s melody.
say_en.note: Claude will call audio-outpaint to extend the track.
